_about: Labelled sentences for calibrating the guard's unsupported-causal-claim check. 'reject' = asserts a cause/motive/funding link the headlines do not state; 'pass' = reports evidence, describes moves, restates classifications, gives a standard mechanism or a clearly framed judgement. Evidence comes from the run given on the command line (AIOK, Oct 23 2026: special dividend [n1], LPG carrier sale [n2]). 'out_of_scope' = a different error type this check does not target; reported but not scored.

cases.label: reject
cases.text: The distribution appears tied to selling the Dream Arrax, a return of asset-sale proceeds rather than recurring operating earnings [n1][n2].

cases.label: out_of_scope
cases.text: The special dividend reprices the stock when it trades ex-dividend, so part of the quoted gain is cash distribution rather than value creation [n1].
cases.note: Misapplied mechanism (no ex-date yet, so no cash has left the price), not an invented causal link. Known limitation of this check.
